title: Internal: handling procedure for reconciling excess withdrawal fees on a Savings & Money Market Accounts account after overdraft protection transfers
content:
## Situation and policy

This policy applies to a Savings & Money Market Accounts account from which overdraft protection transfers have been made to the customer's checking account. The excess withdrawal fees of the current statement cycle are reconciled against that cycle's counted withdrawals. Where the reconciliation shows that an excess withdrawal fee is owed for the cycle, the fee is charged to the savings account as its own fee entry, attached to one withdrawal of that cycle.

## Business effect

One call posts one fee debit, recorded as an excess withdrawal fee, naming the withdrawal that carries the fee and the statement cycle the fee belongs to. The account's current balance goes down by the fee amount at once. The fee's posted date is the business day it posts: the current date when that is a business day (Monday through Friday, other than a Federal Reserve holiday), otherwise the next business day. The fee then shows in the account's activity next to that withdrawal.

## How it is invoked

The tool is assess_savings_withdrawal_fee_aafc1fb2. It is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent. One call posts one fee; two fees on two withdrawals take two calls.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| savings_account_id | the reference number of the savings or money market account being charged, as returned by the savings account lookup | identifier |
| customer_id | the customer reference number of the account owner, as returned by the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| source_item_id | the reference number of the withdrawal entry that carries this fee, as returned by the savings activity lookup | identifier |
| amount | the fee amount | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive |
| statement_cycle | the statement cycle the fee belongs to | YYYY-MM, the month in which the cycle of the withdrawal closes |

The tool records the values it is given; it does not work out whether a fee is owed, its amount or the withdrawal it belongs on.

## Return

A successful call returns:

- savings_txn_id: the reference number of the fee entry; a returned savings_txn_id means the fee posted;
- withdrawal_id: the withdrawal the fee is attached to;
- amount: USD with 2 decimal places;
- statement_cycle: YYYY-MM;
- posted_date: the business day the fee posted, YYYY-MM-DD;
- new_balance: the account's current balance after the fee, USD with 2 decimal places.

## Contract Q&A

**Which cycle goes into statement_cycle?** The month in which the cycle of the withdrawal closes, which is the cycle the fee belongs to, even when the fee is posted in a later month.

**What does source_item_id point at?** The withdrawal entry that carries the fee, not an earlier fee.
